review.why: Fills missing translations of the resume app across web and mobile languages with parallel workers and strict checks.
review.summary: Maintainer workflow: record the git state, extract strings, inventory missing entries per language, give each worker whole language files, seed mobile after web, then run a list of gates (sync check, strict compile, locale diff, lint). Changes are left uncommitted and the report says whether a native speaker reviewed the wording.
strengths: Preserves existing translations and unrelated work
Checks placeholders and plural forms, not just compilation
States that technical completeness is not linguistic quality
cautions: Only for contributors working in the app's own checkout: of no use to someone writing a resume
Runs many package commands and spawns parallel workers
Depends on repository files and scripts that are not in the skill
